title: Phat487
text: IMHO, You need this totally awesome app. I don't know about the other pw apps, I stopped here because it just works. Yes, They had a problem but it's fixed now and I'm happy. Thank you because I have 200 passwords and I can only remember 100 LOL ... I depend on this app to keep me secure and to remember my other 100 passwords. Thank you sooo much. Remember it just works!

title: Better on a computer not so much on mobile
text: I’ve used this for more than 2 yrs & pay the extra for multiple devices. It works great on my laptop or desktop. When I want to use it on my phone or iPad, it’s the pits. I check the settings and they’re right, but the app doesn’t do what it’s supposed to. I’d be better off storing my passwords in a book. Maybe at next renewal,it’s time for a change.

title: iOS app crashes 100% of the time after the latest update
text: Can’t use it at all on my phone. Going to have to switch services after 5 years.

title: Glitchy which is new
text:
This app has been consistent reliable for years. Suddenly the app doesn’t even open. I tried deleting then re-downloading the app multiple times now; each time I try to login the app simply closes out. I’ve never felt so irritated. All of my passwords are within this app and now I can’t log into essential apps. Didn’t think Dashlane could
Ever be unreliable until now. To be unable to access nearly all passwords without warning has triggered me to look into the next best option.
